author: OpenAI Codex
purpose: Local brand icons for independent YouTube and VK Video links on factory video thumbnails and in the shared channel row. No remote image requests at runtime.

assets.confirmation: OFFICIAL_DOWNLOAD: archive linked by the current brand.youtube YouTube Icon page, fetched directly from Google gstatic. Source AI is PDF-compatible.
assets.derivation: Read vector paths from the PDF-compatible official AI using PyMuPDF; preserve two paths and #ff0033 / #ffffff fills; translate coordinate origin and remove empty artboard margins and redundant clip/namespace metadata. No EPS or JavaScript was executed.

terms.type: YouTube brand resource; not an open-source artwork license
observed_guidance: Preserve official proportions and colors; the triangle stays white in the full-color icon.
Provide clear space; no outline, shadow, rotation, skew, stretching or squashing of the mark.
terms.size_guidance_observed: The current page literally states Digital: 100px as its minimum logo height. The compact UI requested by the user uses a smaller icon, so full brand-guideline compliance is not asserted.
terms.project_use: Identify outbound links to the user-supplied YouTube channel/videos; no sponsorship or endorsement claim.

assets.confirmation: OFFICIAL_REPOSITORY: SVG from the VKCOM organization, pinned to the retrieved source commit. A purpose-built VK Video mark; not a generic VK monogram.
assets.derivation: Original SVG geometry, gradient, colors and viewBox unchanged; remove inter-tag formatting whitespace and add full upstream MIT license as an XML comment.

terms.license_preserved: Full MIT license included inside the distributed SVG as an XML comment.
terms.trademark_note: MIT covers the upstream icon code. Use identifies the destination service and does not claim endorsement.
terms.project_use: Identify outbound links to the user-supplied VK Video channel.

checks.active_content: NONE: only svg/g/path/circle/defs/linearGradient/stop elements; no handlers, script, foreignObject or external href
checks.url_references: Only local SVG paint-server fragment #a in the VK Video gradient.
checks.visual_render: YouTube vector rendered and visually inspected. VK geometry rendered; final gradient appearance is delegated to the parent browser QA because the local SVG renderer omits the gradient.
checks.runtime_design_recommendation: White button backgrounds, object-fit:contain, preserve aspect ratio, accessible destination names on anchor links. Do not recolor logos with CSS filters.
checks.browser_qa: PASS: both logos, including the original VK Video gradient, visually inspected in the actual page at 1440x1000 and 390x844; all 16 logo images loaded. Parent verification on 2026-09-10.

research_context.vk_identity_result: Official page fetched; official asset-directory endpoints were not needed after finding the purpose-built icon in VKCOM/icons.
